[LERR.9.8] **On the stream.** A fault fact is recorded as a `FactEmit`
([RFCS.6a]), whose `rule_name` is the fault's rule name ([LERR.9.11]); a consumer identifies a fault fact by its
`schema_name`. Its withdrawal is a `FactWithdraw` like any other. For one fault
the stream carries, in order, the fault atom ([RFCS.21.1]), then the
`FactEmit`, which [LERR.9.7] may place after other atoms of the same
propagation. The integrator receives each as it is recorded, on the stream
callback ([NCBK.2.8]); no separate fault callback follows the `FactEmit`. A replay re-derives the
`FactEmit` and compares it, as it does every `FactEmit` ([LFST.9.2]).
